description: Every update waits 7 days, because a freshly published release is the prime window for a compromised package. Actions stay pinned by SHA, with the tag in a comment. The commit scopes match .releaserc.json: chore(deps) releases a patch, chore(deps-dev) and ci do not.

packageRules.description: Runtime crates: the image ships what Cargo.lock resolves, so a bump releases a patch.
Test-only crates change no image, so they do not release.
GitHub Actions, grouped into one PR.
